description: Source code for FastAPI router handling ingestion endpoints for files and text, including ingestion, listing, and deletion of documents, with dependencies on ingestion service and authentication.

classes.name: IngestTextBody
classes.description: Pydantic model for ingesting text body with filename and text content.

classes.name: IngestResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for responses containing list of ingested documents.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Deprecated endpoint to ingest a file, redirects to ingest_file.

methods.name: ingest_file
methods.description: Endpoint to ingest and process a file, storing its chunks for context.

methods.name: ingest_text
methods.description: Endpoint to ingest and process a text, storing its chunks for context.

methods.name: list_ingested
methods.description: Endpoint to list all ingested documents with their IDs and metadata.

methods.name: delete_ingested
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a specific ingested document by ID.
